1.title: Can Trump’s Arch Be So Tall? A Panel May Redefine a Law to Get to Yes.
1.summary: The proposed 250-foot arch would violate a height limit on Washington structures under the traditional reading of the law. But the panel, now led by the president’s allies, has other ideas.

2.title: US and Iran trade strikes for second night in a row after Trump declares ceasefire 'over'
2.summary: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped 'dramatically' since the lastest attacks began.

3.title: Trump’s Loyal Defender at the Vatican
3.summary: Ambassador Brian Burch must navigate the relationship between the two most prominent American men in the world. His priority is the one in Washington.

4.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Sink Into Violent Cycle After Latest Strikes
4.summary: Attacks on ships were followed by new U.S. strikes on Iran, which responded by firing at Gulf nations. The pattern of hostilities has all but collapsed a cease-fire, with little sign that either side will step back.

6.title: At NATO Summit, Trump Puts on a Show While Europe Gets Down to Business
6.summary: While President Trump insulted allies and demanded loyalty, the military alliance moved quietly closer to accepting more European responsibility for defense.
